records.name: Commercial — Mainline Interruptible Sales (Firm Delivery)
records.eligibility: PUB schedule page 18: annual consumption at least 680,000 m³ through one meter. Direct transmission or dedicated distribution above medium pressure; one-year contract. Winter months are November through March. Monthly billing demand: highest daily m³ consumed in a winter month or a winter month of the preceding eleven months, subject to schedule exceptions; Centra may estimate it without 12 months of data and may allow November/March use without increasing it. Mainline customer electing Interruptible Sales Service in conjunction with Firm Delivery Service (PUB schedule page 18). Section VI interruptible sales terms (page 49): one-year contract, customer-provided stand-by fuel used when Centra gives notice of curtailment. Alternate supply during curtailment has a pass-through commodity/transport price plus the published alternate delivery rate; it is not the default commodity price.

Centra Gas supplies the gas commodity under the default quarterly rate service. A separate fixed-rate commodity contract is offered during designated enrollment periods for one, three or five years; it does not fix delivery or the total bill (Manitoba Hydro gas supply: https://www.hydro.mb.ca/account/rates/natural-gas/). records.description: OEB-approved tariff: Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited / COMPETITIVE SECTOR MULTI-UNIT RESIDENTIAL Service Classification, with OEB RPP ULO commodity prices
records.eligibility: This classification is applicable to an account where electricity is used exclusively for residential purposes in a multi-unit residential building, where unit metering is provided using technology that is substantially similar to that employed by competitive sector sub-metering providers. Use of electricity in non-residential units of multi-unit buildings does not qualify for this classification and will instead be subject to the applicable commercial classification. Class B consumers are defined in accordance with O. Reg. 429/04. Further details concerning the terms of service are available in the distributor’s Conditions of Service.

No negotiated amounts are assumed.
